about.title: Hi, I'm Dewa — a full-stack developer.
about.intro: I design, build, and run web products end to end. I care about software that is fast for visitors, safe with money and data, and cheap enough to operate as one person.
about.body: This hub is where that comes together: the blog where I share what I learn, the account that signs you in to all my products, and the billing that keeps them running.
about.portfolioDescription: Things I have designed and built from the first document to production.
